hero_slots.scene_description:
PRODUCT: Matte black night vision device, kept true to original shape, color and size proportions, visible control buttons and lens, positioned as the clear central focal point.
ATMOSPHERE: Set at a dim residential community perimeter on a no-moon late night, soft warm side light comes from distant security street lamps, blurred background of shrubs and low boundary walls matches real patrol use scenarios.
LAYOUT: Product occupies 48% of the square frame, placed exactly at the center. Hook headline spans the entire top band, three benefit bullets are placed evenly at upper right, lower left, and lower right around the product, no overlapping elements, total text area accounts for less than 32% of frame height.
TYPOGRAPHY: Hook uses condensed bold italic sans-serif in bright neon green, 2.7x the height of proof text. Benefit names use semi-bold geometric sans in neon green, proof text uses regular sans in light gray, strictly following the size hierarchy Hook >> Name > Proof.
DECOR: No icons, badges, CTA buttons or leader lines added, only thin subtle hairline dividers between each benefit zone to keep sections clear, ample clean negative space around all elements with no extra decorative clutter.

detail_slots.scene_description:
PRODUCT: The low-light observation device retains its original shape, color and proportions, optically centered in the mid-frame at 45% of canvas width, with a soft natural shadow for a grounded feel, no flat studio paste-on effect.
ATMOSPHERE: Set at a residential community perimeter right after sunset, warm soft side light illuminates the scene, with surrounding trees and paved walkway visible in the background, matching night patrol use scenarios.
LAYOUT: 3:4 portrait canvas with 4% safe margin on all edges, top 20% kept clear for overlay text, middle 50% holds the product hero, bottom 30% is a seamless smooth paved walkway with no painted panels, gutters or divider lines.
TYPOGRAPHY: No text, numbers or glyphs are painted on the base; all headline, subhead, story copy and icons will be added later via system overlay.
DECOR: No pre-painted icons, badges or decorative marks on the base; only subtle natural details like small fallen leaves on the bottom walkway surface, no artificial accent elements.
